transformers.note: library_name is `cosmos`; the documented inference engines are vLLM-Omni, vLLM and PyTorch, and the card shows no transformers example. Loading it through AutoModelForImageTextToText is not a documented usage.

resources._note: One card per worker on 96 GB hardware. The two-card rule was never a memory constraint: eight workers decoding 400-second episodes concurrently exhausted decoder resources (swscaler EAGAIN) on 104 of 150 episode questions, and halving the concurrent decodes was the cheapest fix. Re-measured 2026-09-11 on the 96 GB host (192 threads, 1.7 TB RAM) by running the decode alone, without the model: transformers 5.15.0 load_video over the 48 longest episodes in the pool (129-414 frames) at concurrency 8 completed 48/48 with no failures. The decode backend is unchanged between the two hosts - PyAV 18.1.0, pinned identically in both lockfiles. What differs is the core count. If swscaler EAGAIN appears in the log, put this back to 2; the probe covered the decode call in isolation, not the processor path under eight resident models.
